result.instructions: Tools for Kisi, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kisi data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run kisi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kisi_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kisi_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. kisi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kisi_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: The Kisi user the API key belongs to (id, name, email, organization). Good first call. GET /user.

tools.name: kisi_get_organization
tools.title: Get the organization
tools.description: The current Kisi organization (name, domain, settings summary). GET /organization.

tools.name: kisi_list_places
tools.title: List places
tools.description: List places (sites/buildings) in the organization with address, time zone and lock/member counts. GET /places.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of ids to fetch.

offset.description: Results to skip (offset paging; use pagination.next_offset).

tools.name: kisi_get_place
tools.title: Get a place
tools.description: One place by id, including lockdown state. GET /places/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_locks
tools.title: List locks (doors)
tools.description: List locks/doors with their state: online, unlocked, locked_down, configured, place and floor. Filter to find offline or locked-down doors. GET /locks.

configured.description: Filter by whether the lock is configured.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of ids to fetch.

offset.description: Results to skip (offset paging; use pagination.next_offset).

tools.name: kisi_get_lock
tools.title: Get a lock (door)
tools.description: One lock/door by id: online/unlocked/locked-down state, place, floor, settings. GET /locks/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_groups
tools.title: List access groups
tools.description: List access groups (who-can-open-what bundles of doors). Filter by place or by a lock to see which groups open that door. GET /groups.

lock_id.description: Only groups that include this lock.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of ids to fetch.

offset.description: Results to skip (offset paging; use pagination.next_offset).

tools.name: kisi_get_group
tools.title: Get an access group
tools.description: One access group by id (name, description, place, member/lock counts, restrictions). GET /groups/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_group_locks
tools.title: List a group's locks
tools.description: The locks/doors an access group opens. GET /group_locks?group_id=.

offset.description: Results to skip (offset paging; use pagination.next_offset).

tools.name: kisi_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users (members) of the organization. Filter by group or place (users with access there), email, or free text over name/email/notes. Sort by last unlock. GET /users.

query.description: Free-text search over user email, name and notes.

place_id.description: Only users with access to this place.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of ids to fetch.

offset.description: Results to skip (offset paging; use pagination.next_offset).

tools.name: kisi_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: One user by id. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_role_assignments
tools.title: List role assignments (access rights)
tools.description: Who holds which role where: a user/team/guest's role on the organization, a place or a group (group members = door access). Filter by user, group, place or role. GET /role_assignments.

role_id.description: Filter by role id, e.g. group_basic, group_manager, place_owner, organization_administrator.

query.description: Free-text search over user email and name.

offset.description: Results to skip (offset paging; use pagination.next_offset).

tools.name: kisi_list_cards
tools.title: List access cards
tools.description: List access cards with status (activated/deactivated/unassigned), assignee and last use. GET /cards.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of ids to fetch.

offset.description: Results to skip (offset paging; use pagination.next_offset).

tools.name: kisi_list_presences
tools.title: List presences at a place
tools.description: Who was present at a place on a given day (derived from unlocks): actor, first/last unlock, last door. GET /presences.

date.description: The day: a date (2026-10-08) or an RFC 3339 date-time with offset (2026-10-08T09:00:00+02:00). Kisi reads it as a day in the place's time zone; a bare date is sent as noon UTC of that day.

offset.description: Results to skip (offset paging; use pagination.next_offset).

tools.name: kisi_list_schedules
tools.title: List schedules
tools.description: Time rules: when a group's access is allowed, when doors auto-unlock (unlock timer), first-to-arrive, elevator permit timers. Filter by consequence or by the group/lock it applies to. GET /schedules.

consequence.description: Filter by what the schedule does.

scheduleable_type.description: Type of the object (use with scheduleable_id).

scheduleable_id.description: Id of the group/lock/elevator stop (use with scheduleable_type).

ids.description: Comma-separated list of ids to fetch.

offset.description: Results to skip (offset paging; use pagination.next_offset).

tools.name: kisi_list_controllers
tools.title: List controllers
tools.description: Kisi controllers (door hardware hubs) with online/offline status. Filter by place, lock or status. GET /controllers.

lock_id.description: Only the controller of this lock.

query.description: Free-text search over name, device id and token.

offset.description: Results to skip (offset paging; use pagination.next_offset).

tools.name: kisi_list_readers
tools.title: List readers
tools.description: Kisi readers (card/phone readers at doors) with model and online/offline status. GET /readers.

query.description: Free-text search over name, device id and token.

offset.description: Results to skip (offset paging; use pagination.next_offset).

tools.name: kisi_search_events
tools.title: Search access events
tools.description: Search the access log (unlocks, denied attempts, lockdowns, admin changes) and return the first page. This CREATES a temporary saved search in Kisi (an event set, cursor-paginated, kept ~24 h); it changes no door, user or access right. Defaults to the past 90 days, the maximum width. If status is still in_progress or cursor is set, call kisi_get_event_set with the returned id. POST /event_sets.

interval.description: ISO 8601 interval on event time, max 90 days: start/end (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z/2026-10-08T00:00:00Z), start/duration (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z/P7D) or duration/end (P1D/2026-10-08T00:00:00Z).

type.description: Event type(s), comma-separated, e.g. lock.unlock (see kisi_list_event_types).

actor_id.description: Only events by this actor (e.g. a user id).

object_type.description: Object type, e.g. Lock, Place, Group, User (use with object_id).

object_id.description: Only events about this object (e.g. a lock id).

tools.name: kisi_get_event_set
tools.title: Get an event set page
tools.description: Read an event set from kisi_search_events: its status and events. Pass the previous page's cursor for the next page. GET /event_sets/{id}.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page.

tools.name: kisi_list_event_types
tools.title: List event types
tools.description: All event type names usable as the type filter of kisi_search_events (e.g. lock.unlock). GET /events/types.
